The '''Syngia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]], which connected it to the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna]] and [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the celestial body [[Syngia]]<ref name="TJP" /> and the [[Syngia moon]].<ref name="TDR" />
